WHY THIS COULD MATTER

A testable response to a documented repair gap

Australia's Productivity Commission found significant and unnecessary barriers to repair for some products and identified restricted access to repair information among them. Australia's environment department reports 511,000 tonnes of e-waste were created in 2019.
